mapper.select: SELECT vrt.review_type AS reviewType, vrt.review_type_name AS reviewTypeName, vrt.description AS description FROM vitamate_review_type vrt WHERE vrt.enabled = TRUE ORDER BY vrt.sort_order ASC, vrt.review_type ASC

SELECT vrt.review_type AS reviewType, vrt.category_code AS categoryCode, vrt.category_name AS categoryName, vrt.guide_text AS guideText, vrt.example_text AS exampleText, vrt.prompt_template AS promptTemplate, vrt.template_version AS templateVersion, vrt.sort_order AS sortOrder FROM vitamate_review_template vrt WHERE vrt.enabled = TRUE ORDER BY vrt.review_type ASC, vrt.sort_order ASC, vrt.category_code ASC

SELECT vat.review_type AS reviewType, vat.category_code AS categoryCode, vat.category_name AS categoryName, NULL AS guideText, NULL AS exampleText, vat.prompt_template AS promptTemplate, vat.template_version AS templateVersion, vat.sort_order AS sortOrder FROM vitamate_analysis_template vat WHERE vat.vitamate_analysis_id = #{analysisId} AND vat.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY vat.sort_order ASC, vat.category_code ASC
